goal: Build a URL shortener service that creates and redirects short links and rate limits link creation.

functional.text: Create a short link for a long URL
acceptance: POST /api/urls returns 201 with a unique short code
Invalid or unsafe target URLs are rejected with 400
Creating the same URL again for the same client returns the existing link

functional.text: Redirect a short code to its target URL
acceptance: GET /{code} answers 302 with the target in Location
Requests above the per-client quota answer 429 with Retry-After
The quota window resets after it elapses

assumptions: No end-user authentication in this iteration: clients are identified by the X-Client-Id header or IP (spoofable).
Single-instance deployment with in-memory storage behind a repository abstraction.
